content: {"question":"How does GitLab’s equity program for managers interact with the length of primary carer leave available to New Zealand employees?","answer":"Managers receive RSUs with a six‑month cliff, while New Zealand employees who qualify as primary carers can take up to 26 weeks of continuous paid leave.","evidence_a":"Industry‑leading six‑month cliff for new hire RSUs; no cliff for promotion/refresh grants","evidence_b":"Primary Carer Leave can last up to 26 weeks and must be taken in one continuous period."}
